summary_md: **Anish Mahapatra ([@_anishmahapatra](https://x.com/_anishmahapatra/status/2115458063507276133))** summarizes **Measuring Agents in Production**, a survey of 86 practitioners: 68% of agents run 10 or fewer steps before a human steps in, 70% prompt off-the-shelf models rather than fine-tune, and 74% rely mainly on human evaluation.
relevance: Ground truth on how production agents are actually built and evaluated.
